verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents custom dashboards as configurable collections of charts for the metrics that matter to your application, with group-by on run tag or metadata. Prebuilt per-project dashboards cover error rates and token usage, and dashboards are positioned for tracking quality. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that latency, cost, and eval/feedback-score metrics can be charted in custom dashboards (these are only explicitly listed for alerts), and independent or hands-on corroboration of building such dashboards.
